title: VitaFit Android application (com.vt.vitafit) before 2.8.1.0 contains a hardcoded credentials vulnerability that allows…
description: The VitaFit Android application (com.vt.vitafit) versions before 2.8.1.0 contain a hardcoded credentials vulnerability. Attackers can extract confidential third-party integration secrets by decompiling the APK, including credentials for WeChat, Tencent QQ, and Fitbit. This allows potential abuse of active third-party application registrations.
